name: sort under a restricted move
mechanism: order a sequence using only one permitted operation (reversing a prefix), placing the largest unsorted element by at most two moves each round

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Pancake sorting' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Sequence sorting:

fails_when: minimal move count is hard in general; the greedy bound is 2n
